summary: Ran comprehensive backend (pytest, 14 tests) and end-to-end frontend (Playwright) tests for CRED HR app. All backend APIs work correctly. All frontend flows (Report landing, Onboarding, Dashboard, JobSetup, JobDetail, CandidateProfile with multi-role assignment, PublicApply auto-apply) work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: review_request referred to a fixed share slug 'job-match-simple-2' but backend actually generates 8-char hex slugs (see server.py Job.share_slug default). Tests correctly used dynamic slugs from GET /api/jobs. If a stable, human-readable slug is desired, main agent should update the Job model to generate slugs from title + counter.
Report.js hero text 'We rebuilt the talent engine' is split across two elements (line 73-75) which is fine for humans but tricky for exact-text selectors. Not a bug.
server.py: fine overall; MongoDB _id correctly stripped via strip_mongo helper. CORS wide-open (*) is acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all tested testids/flows work; two initial cosmetic test-selector timeouts on multi-node hero text and wait_for_url timing were resolved via alternative verification — publish actually navigated to /app/jobs/{id} as confirmed by jd-copy-link-btn appearing)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 4 jobs + 20 candidates on startup automatically. Tests created 1 test job (cleaned up) and 1 test candidate via /api/apply (TEST_ prefix, kept as it exercises real flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend fully working. Use dynamic share_slug from GET /api/jobs (8-char hex) for PublicApply testing — not the placeholder 'job-match-simple-2' in the request. All data-testid attributes exist and are consistent. Dashboard shows role_cards_count=5 and cand_rows_count=21 after test runs (baseline 4 + 20, +1 each from test flows).
verified_flows: POST /api/extract-skills returns React/TypeScript/Design Systems + salary + questions
POST /api/apply/{slug} creates auto_applied candidate + returns match_score
Report / hero + CTAs navigate to /app and /onboarding
Dashboard 5 KPIs, roles grid, 20+ candidate rows, search/stage/role filters, bulk action bar, row click -> profile, dash-new-role-btn
JobSetup: title input, fill sample -> live extraction with skills/salary/screening questions, publish -> /app/jobs/{id}
CandidateProfile: match score, stage buttons, rating buttons, add-role toggles (multi-role verified with role chips), tabs, stage update
PublicApply: demo btn -> scanning -> auto-filled form (pa-name/email/phone/title/company/exp/ctc) -> submit -> 'Applied.' success with match score
